reference.name: Late Blight
reference.symptoms: Water-soaked irregular spots on leaves that turn brown/black. White cottony growth on the underside during humid weather. Rapid necrosis of vines.
reference.treatment: Ensure proper drainage and use healthy seed tubers. Preventative sprays of Mancozeb 75 WP or systemic fungicides like Metalaxyl are recommended. Consult ICAR-CPRI guidelines for exact dosage.
